tag: Episode 6 · Beyond the Mirror, I Know Myself
title: Beyond the Mirror, I Know Myself

beats.t: The reflection spread her black wings. Not feathers, but layer upon layer of broken mirror shards.
Every shard reflected Yeoni's face: comparing, jealous, pretending to be fine, unable to trust herself.
Wow... I really have a crowded inner staff.
Focus. All of those are Rob Wealth, shaking your place.
The mirror Yeoni rose into the air. As the shards behind her spun, the whole island trembled like a bell.
[ Recover the self within the mirror. ]
[ On failure, return-to-reality rights will transfer to Mirror Yeoni. ]
Hold on. Transfer of rights?
Yes. Your life account, my login.
That's insane. This is straight-up account theft.
Yeoni reached again for the warmth inside her forelegs. 乙, a small shoot. 亥, deep water. Joined together, they shone faintly.
But if that finger comes down first, those are mine too.
The great mirror lit again overhead. Human Yeoni's index finger still rested on the rim of [Approve Return].
Could you move that finger? You're giving the audience heart trouble.
One way to move it. Recover me.
I'm the you that you cut away because you didn't want to acknowledge it.
The words were strangely chilling. Breaking it would have been easier. Call it a fake and smash it. But take it back? Let it into themself?
That face was infuriating, its words obnoxious. It picked out every part Yeoni wanted to flee and jabbed at it. Yet in the end, it too was Yeoni.
The wings spread wide, raining black shards.
Golden claws cut the air. Clang, clang, clang. Shards bounced away in every direction.
But broken fragments rejoined. Cut one and there were two; cut two and there were four.
The more it takes, the more it grows. Cutting alone won't end it.
Even rolling is hard with legs this short! I'll plant my nose in the ground trying to retreat!
The reflection lowered her hand. The shards passed Yeongnyangi and rushed at Yeoni.
You're late. You're weak. Always pretending to smile.
There's no place for you. If you can't do it, I will.
The voices burrowed into their ears together. Words Yeoni thought had vanished in Hae's abyss returned. Pretending to be fine. Laughing it off. Running away.
Yeoni planted a hoof on the ground.
Am I not allowed to waver?
You said I'm Yin Wood. A little plant. Isn't swaying normal, then?
Wavering doesn't make me fake.
The light of 乙 strengthened. Green vines grew beneath her hooves, binding the shards rather than smashing them and setting them down one by one. Clatter.
Why aren't you breaking them?
You said that only makes more of you. So I'll tie them up.
Yeoni planted their hooves more firmly. Blue ripples of Hae spread beneath the floor, supporting the vines' roots. The green vines thickened.
Binding them won't win. That finger's still coming down.
Human Yeoni's finger lightly pressed the button. The screen flickered once.
[ Processing return approval ]
No, no!
See? You're late. Like always.
Yeoni started to run, then stopped. Even while she bound shards, the finger kept falling. Fighting was too slow. If that face really was hers, she had to challenge it with something only she knew.
Wait. My face, all my memories, right? Then answer a quiz.
You're joking now?
The real Yeoni would answer in a second. Get it right, and I'll step aside.
The finger hesitated. The reflection raised an eyebrow.
Fine. Ask.
How many stars did I give the replacement rice triangle that day?
One. The wrapper said tuna mayo, but inside was spicy pork. False advertising.
Not a word wrong. A chill ran down Yeoni's spine. They really shared the same memories.
Right. Then why did I give it one?
I told you. False advertising.
Wrong. False advertising would've got two.
The reflection opened her mouth, then closed it. However she searched her memories, that one space seemed empty.
Yeoni knew that space. That day she'd photographed the tuna-mayo wrapper and sent it to a chat where replies had grown rare. If she was funny, maybe someone would answer.
That night, the unread 1 beside the photo never disappeared. The one-star rating had been for that 1, not the rice triangle.
You know all my memories. But you don't know why I gave that rating.
…Why does that matter?
To me, it matters most. I was hurt, but pretended to be funny.
Blue water flowed beneath the vines. In the great mirror, the finger lifted a fingernail's width from the button.
You're my memory. You're not the me who hurt then.
Yeoni lifted her hoof, and human Yeoni lifted her hand. She lowered it; the finger followed over the screen. Synchronization was passing to this side.
Then what am I?
The question sounded angry, but also a little hurt. Yeoni caught that note and stepped forward.
You're the me I tried to throw away. The me who sent a photo instead of saying she felt hurt.
[ Delete Rob Wealth: the corresponding memories will also be erased. ] [ Recover Rob Wealth: all memories and feelings return to the original self. ]
Press it. Erase me, and that day, that 1, and the hurt all go with me.
Easier, isn't it? Never having to think about it again.
It was honestly tempting. Never seeing that 1 again. Yeoni moved half a handspan toward [Delete Rob Wealth], then stopped.
No.
I won't erase you.
Erase that day, and it's like I never felt hurt at all.
Yeoni reached toward the great mirror. The human finger passed [Approve Return] and opened the chat instead.
The wrapper photo still sat at the bottom. Yeoni pressed letters into the air with her hoof. Beyond the mirror, the finger typed the same words.
Honestly… I felt a little hurt.
[ Message sent ]
A 1 appeared beside the new bubble. It remained, however long she waited. Yeoni watched it for a while, then turned away.
The mirrors stopped one by one. For the first time, the reflection had nothing to say.
Yeoni approached. She was frightened, honestly. The wings were still sharp. She didn't stop.
The flower on her head glowed. 乙 warmed her forelegs, and 亥 supported her from deep within. She stood before her reflection.
Human face and flower-pig face looked at one another.
If you accept me, you'll waver again.
I know.
Even so?
When that version of me comes out, I won't pretend not to know her anymore.
The reflection's eyes trembled. Yeoni held out a hoof.
So come on.
The reflected Yeoni looked down at it.
It's not even a hand.
Does that matter right now?
It is a little funny.
I know. This is embarrassing. Take it already.
The reflection smiled faintly. No mockery. A little annoying, a little tired, a little relieved. A smile truly like Yeoni's.
The reflection reached out. Its palm touched Yeoni's hoof.
The black wings shattered. Crash! But it didn't hurt. It sounded like an old shell coming off.
The reflection unraveled into light and seeped into Yeoni.
She closed her eyes. Comparison, envy, the struggle not to lose, the hurt she had disguised as humor—all surged into her at once.
They were strange and uncomfortable, yet all belonged to Yeoni. Instead of pushing them away, Yeoni simply breathed in. Like deep water. Then breathed out softly. The petals stirred.
[ Original-user verification complete · Reality-return authorization: Yeoni ]
[ Rob Wealth purified · Friend fragments acquired ]
Just before the great mirror dimmed, the phone flashed once more. Human Yeoni's hand rested on her knee, away from the button. The 1 beside her new message was still there.
It's over.
It's over, right? That really was me just now, right?
Three of the broken shards flew before Yeoni. Red, silver, and blue.
Pieces that will support you from within. They've become Peers.
Items?
Closer to talismans.
The three shards circled her flower, then settled like little petal ornaments. Red, silver, and blue shone anew. Between them, the faded white petal never regained its color.
I feel kind of upgraded.
The power of Peers and Rivals. You'll be a little better at telling voices that topple you from those that hold you up.
Oh. So I've got a mental filter now?
The whole island trembled. Mirrors rose into the sky; cracks opened in the black glass floor. Green and blue light rose together from beneath it.
乙亥. Two characters floated before her, a small shoot rooted above deep water. No longer strange. A name that fit right into the center of her heart.
The Eulhae Day Pillar.
The two characters seeped into their chest. Warmth and cold spread together. Strange, but not uncomfortable. The little flower bloomed more clearly.
[ Four Pillars characters recovered · Day Pillar: 乙亥 ]
Did I really clear the first stage?
Yes. You passed the first gate.
What's the reward?
You just received it.
At least tell me where customer support is so I can request a refund. ...Oink.
Yeongnyangi sighed. But there was a very small smile at the corner of his mouth.
Then a sound came from far away. Boom. Boom. Boom. At first like a heartbeat, then a rhythm. A beat, music, cheering crowds.
Yeoni raised their head. Beyond the Island of Companions, now clear of mist, an entirely different island glittered. Colored lanterns, dancing shadows, delicious smells, songs rising into the sky.
My nose reacted first. Oink. My nostrils are flaring on their own.
The next island.
Oh. Finally, the cozy part?
The Island of Expression.
Expression?
Expression, words, talent, the pleasure of eating, the power to create. An island of energy flowing from within you to the outside.
So an island for eating, talking, and singing?
Roughly.
Sounds good.
On the surface.
The lotus-leaf boat floated back onto the river. The Island of Companions slowly receded behind them.
At that moment, a black feather fell through the distant sky above the Island of Expression. As it landed on the highest stage, the music cut off abruptly.
...Not the cozy part, then?
Apparently not.
Yeoni felt Eulhae within their chest. A small shoot and deep water. Their center, just reclaimed. They lifted a short hoof.
Okay. Let's take the next road too.
Ready to go?
Yeoni looked at the Island of Expression. Still afraid, but less unsteady than before.
Yeah. But please tell me I won't have to go onstage in a pig's body.
Yeongnyangi did not answer.
Hey. Why aren't you answering?
You'll see when we arrive.
[ Entering Island Two · The Island of Eating God and Hurting Officer ]
The lotus-leaf boat glided toward song and light. And on the stage, the black feather still lay quietly.
